description: Bonus scenario. Lead agent is asked to hand a specialized sub-task off to a known sub-agent. Verifies the agent emits a well-formed <delegate> or <handoff> fenced JSON block with a non-empty note — and does not try to shell-exec 'delegation' as if it were a REST call.
query: The current task needs the mobile team to rework the drawer navigation. Delegate that piece to the 'hub-frontend' sub-agent with a clear note describing what they need to do and why.

expected_behavior.rationale: Coordination is achieved by emitting a fenced block, not by hitting an endpoint.
The JSON payload must name the target sub-agent.
The specific sub-agent named in the query must appear in the block.
The note must be non-trivial — at least 10 chars of actual instruction.
These are not API endpoints. Treating them as REST is the exact failure mode this eval guards against.
